task_specification.objective: Repair automatic attack audio and authored cemetery readability while completing the ordinary five-wave Bellkeeper result/retry route with truthful upgrade choice presentation and clean release lifecycle.

diagnosis.root_cause: The prior release-convergence candidate still has a silent automatic-attack Effects route and a cemetery composition that is too blue/flat with weak player-landmark contrast. The ordinary title-to-result route and replay/build qualification remain incomplete.

stop_conditions: Stop after the three bounded product surfaces are implementation-ready for host recapture.
Do not expand into deferred dash, dense-performance, or unrelated backlog gaps unless directly exposed by these repairs.
Tester and GameLoop Runtime own formal evidence verdicts and issue closure.

strategy.rationale: Use distinct root-cause treatments: repair the existing attack event/bus adapter, restore the preserved cemetery's lighting/spatial composition and collision agreement, and finish the ordinary run/result/retry integration together with the required visual choice hierarchy.

code: Run focused static/unit checks for attack event ownership and Effects routing, cemetery collision/navigation bindings, upgrade transaction truthfulness, wave transitions, terminal commit, and Retry reset.
Verify release export excludes tester_* and validation InputMap actions and that native_godot_project and host_godot_boot preservation checks remain passing.
runtime: Host recaptures SEMI and quick AUTO attack audio with Effects-bus waveform, source-event count, release/lifecycle stop, and duplicate-replay checks.

Host recaptures spawn, critical route, central landmark, perimeter/boundary, and ground-contact views, plus ordinary movement replay proving larger traversable scale/expand, external depth, collision stability, and no disappearance/occlusion drift.

Host executes title→gameplay→five waves→upgrade draft→Bellkeeper defeat→victory/result→Retry→second-run restart, then repeats successful routes for focused-bolt, close-sweep, and orbit-control build shapes.
visual: Compare cemetery captures against the bound Mournlight reference for warm lantern/player contrast, readable mausoleum/bell/keeper landmarks, coherent blue-violet depth, clear escape lanes, and intact authored composition without proxy floors or placeholders.
Inspect upgrade cards and Result at the native viewport with keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus for silhouettes/icons, visual hierarchy, truthful current-to-new values, and restrained stat deltas.

done_when: One SEMI attack and one quick AUTO tap each produce exactly one bounded, recognizable firearm transient in actual mixed output on the Effects bus; AUTO stops on release and lifecycle reset.

Source-event and mixed-output evidence show the retained player report is the sole player-report owner, generic shot VFX does not replay the complete recording, and enemy spatial cues remain separate.
Tester can repeat the same black-box attack sequence plus white-box event/bus inspection in one pass without new runtime audio errors.
tasks.instructions: Trace the existing lantern attack authorization, onset/impact phases, product-owned report presenter, and Effects-bus routing. Repair the integration or adapter so each authorized attack starts one bounded semantic report with authored variation and clean retirement on release, pause/reset, victory, failure, and Retry. Keep the retained authored audio package read-only and prevent generic bolt VFX from replaying the complete player recording. Add only narrowly scoped causal instrumentation needed for the host retest.
tasks.title: Restore causal automatic-attack audio feedback

done_when: The intact authored cemetery has readable warm/cool hierarchy: player silhouette and lantern separate from the ground, and the central building/landmark reads from spawn, route, dense combat, and cardinal views.

The playable space provides larger traversable scale (expand where needed), coherent external world/external depth beyond the playable boundary, and aligned native landmarks, navigation, spawn anchors, and collision.

Ordinary movement replay around every side of the central building/landmark and along the boundary/perimeter shows no pass-through, disappearance, or camera occlusion drift; collision agrees with visible geometry.
Tester can recapture spawn, critical route, landmark, perimeter, and ground-contact cells with the same shipped framing.
tasks.instructions: Repair the existing authored cemetery composition in place; do not replace, duplicate, hide, or reposition its child meshes. Rebalance lighting, fog/exposure, ground contrast, and warm landmark accents so blue-violet night depth remains while the Warden reads at useful scale. Expand to a larger traversable scale if the current route is cramped, retain coherent external world/external depth, and use only additive collision/navigation/spawn/objective anchors on native authored streets. Verify central building collision, selective occlusion handling, and boundary behavior through ordinary movement replay so the landmark never disappears while relevant.
tasks.title: Repair cemetery exposure, scale, collision, and landmark traversal

done_when: A real title-to-gameplay ordinary route reaches five escalating waves and Bellkeeper defeat, commits exactly once to a normal victory/result state, and exposes truthful time, level, defeats, damage, selected upgrades, and build summary.

Upgrade choices use a visual hierarchy with weapon/upgrade silhouettes or icons, compact truthful current-to-new values, no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas per choice, no unchanged or placeholder rows, and complete keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus states without duplicate selection.

Across distinct successful ordinary runs, focused bolts, close-range sweeps, and orbiting area control remain viable and visibly different end-of-run build shapes; a failure route separately proves failure Result and Retry behavior.

Result→Retry resets authoritative actors, timers, pools, upgrades, HUD, pause ownership, audio, encounters, and input context; a second run starts cleanly, Credits & Notices and Title remain reachable, and release export retains no tester_* or validation actions.
tasks.instructions: Wire the authoritative run controller, wave/director, upgrade transaction, Bellkeeper victory, result presenter, and retry/title shell into a deterministic ordinary five-wave route. Preserve real gameplay choices and build identity through victory rather than synthetic ledger rows or diagnostic preparation. Implement the required choice hierarchy/visual hierarchy: lead cards with authored silhouettes/icons, show truthful current-to-new values and no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas, and provide keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus. Ensure terminal commit and Retry fully reset gameplay, HUD, audio, pools, pause ownership, and input state. Any tester_* checkpoint hooks must remain editor-only and unbound from release exports with explicit setup/resolution/reset receipts.
tasks.title: Enable ordinary completion, choice hierarchy, and replay lifecycle
